requirement.title: Interoperable sources and services
requirement.question: Can a third-party catalogue, service, module or agent connect via documented APIs?
requirement.acceptance: Prove one end-to-end import/export with source and permission boundaries.

observations.finding: AIoD Metadata Catalogue has an official REST API and Python SDK, suitable for a future read-only adapter evaluation.
Contributor onboarding accepts eligible mature research tools, services and catalogues under review; not an unconditional publication API.
Modules expose a common API and can be deployed to local or federated resources; standard DEEPaaS integration is documented.
Project plans plug-in agent orchestration and interoperability integrated with EOSC and AI4EOSC.
